design.theme.title: Theme
design.theme.help: Colors for the panel and settings, and for the desktop pet's bubbles, can be set separately.
design.panelTheme.title: Panel theme
design.panelTheme.help: Pick a theme for light mode, dark mode or both. Each mode uses one theme at a time; applying one here replaces the current one. Themes apply to the whole app, including permission and risk prompts; Agent Pets only accepts themes that keep every label readable and danger, success, warning and info colours recognisable.
design.panelTheme.unavailablePluginDisab: The plugin providing this theme is turned off, so the built-in look is shown.
design.panelTheme.unavailablePluginsOff: Plugins are turned off, so the built-in look is shown.
design.panelTheme.unavailableRemoved: The selected theme is no longer available, so the built-in look is shown.
design.panelTheme.suspendedForcedColors: Suspended while Windows high-contrast is on.
design.panelTheme.error.imageInvalid: This image can't be used. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP of at least 64 × 64 pixels.
design.panelTheme.error.imageTooLarge: This image is too large. Use one up to 20 MB and 8192 pixels per side.
design.panelTheme.error.imageAnimated: Animated images can't be used as a background.
design.panelTheme.error.imageNotAllowed: This theme does not allow a background image in this mode.
design.panelTheme.error.themeUnavailable: This theme is no longer available.
design.panelTheme.error.writeFailed: The change couldn't be saved. Try again.
design.panelTheme.statusHelp: Use a theme from a plugin, or make your own with Customize…. Plugin themes are picked in the plugin's tab or in Settings → Plugins → the plugin → Panel themes; your own themes are listed under My themes below.
design.panelTheme.pluginOff: Turn this plugin on to use its panel themes.
design.themeEditor.myThemesHelp: Make your own theme: pick every colour, a gradient or your own background image, a font and the corner radius. Agent Pets checks it with the same rules as plugin themes, so every label stays readable.
design.themeEditor.deleteBody: The theme and its background images are removed. A mode that uses it goes back to the built-in look.
design.themeEditor.empty: No themes of your own yet.
design.themeEditor.error.limitReached: You already have 50 themes. Delete one first.
design.themeEditor.error.importInvalid: This file isn’t an Agent Pets theme.
design.themeEditor.error.invalid: This theme doesn’t pass the checks.
design.themeEditor.error.invalidRequest: That request wasn’t accepted. Check the theme and try again.
